name: Image Composition-based Parallel Particle Based Volume Rendering
aliases: Image Composition-based Parallel Particle Based Volume Rendering (PBVR)
Parallel Particle-Based Volume Rendering (PBVR) with Sort-Last Image Composition
definition: A parallel PBVR approach that reduces memory cost by gathering and processing image data (color and depth) instead of particle data. It uses a sort-last parallel image composition approach where each rendering node generates a partial image from an assigned sub-volume, which are then gathered, merged, and ensemble averaged.
summary: This memory-efficient parallel PBVR technique reduces consumption by processing image data instead of particles, eliminating them after projection to maintain constant memory usage.
